title: Bug when remapping keys º to ~, + to ´, ~ to º and ´ to +
author: shadoloo

status.label: Ready for focused reproduction
status.detail: The issue is deterministic and supplies the full remap cycle and output sequence.

next_action.label: E
next_action.reason: Reproduce the cycle under Portuguese layouts and ensure injected targets are not remapped again or followed by unsuppressed originals.

judgment.rationale: The issue is deterministic and supplies the full remap cycle and output sequence.
evidence: Two mapped physical keys produce remapped+original doubled characters.
Shifted dead-key variants show the same structural failure.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the cycle under Portuguese layouts and ensure injected targets are not remapped again or followed by unsuppressed originals.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt covers this cyclic OEM/dead-key graph.

issue_context.summary: Cyclic Keyboard Manager remaps among Portuguese-layout dead/OEM keys eventually emit both the remapped glyph and the original physical glyph.
known_information: The report defines four exact cyclic remaps and their wrong doubled outputs.
The same doubling occurs with Shift variants.
A commenter recognizes the behavior as a generic cyclic-swap problem.
inferences: Injected target events may be reinterpreted by another source mapping in the cycle, or the original key event may escape suppression after target injection.
issue_context.analysis: The exact remap graph can be covered with a low-level event test under Portuguese layouts. The current engine has explicit injected-event flags, making cycle detection/suppression the focused boundary.
initial_investigation: KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp distinguishes Keyboard Manager injected events from physical events.
No upstream pull request references issue 20220.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Start the bounded fork-side design workflow. This draft performs no upstream write.

actions.label: E
actions.note: Local maintainer verification only; no GitHub write is performed.

proposed_fixes.title: Make cyclic key remaps single-pass
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The event pipeline likely allows an injected target or unsuppressed physical event to traverse another edge in the remap cycle, producing the expected glyph plus the original/cycled glyph.
plan: Add an event-level test for the four-key Portuguese cycle with normal and Shift states.
Mark the complete injected sequence as terminal for Keyboard Manager remapping while preserving delivery to applications.
Balance dead-key and modifier state so each physical key produces exactly one target sequence.
verification: Type each key repeatedly under Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal) layouts and verify exactly one mapped glyph per press with and without Shift.

confidence.rationale: The doubled output and cyclic graph strongly indicate re-entry or suppression failure, but layout/dead-key tracing is needed to choose the exact branch.
